title: DPcopy
description: English: Add a packet folder in a specific directory to all worlds. This protects your broken high server from data loss after exporting to non-world. | 翻译：将特定目录中的数据包文件夹添加给所有世界。以此来保护您的破限高服务器中非world世界导出后数据丢失.
body:
# ![DPcopy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/047c390eed5ae088bc9f28b338ad5d66b2072675.png)
# English Description
**Add a packet folder in a specific directory to all worlds. This protects your broken high server from data loss after exporting to non-world**


_**usage：**_
- Paste the datapacks folder and its subfiles in plugins/DPcopy/dp
- Use /doalldatapacks to paste the above file to all non-world worlds in the game
- In the game, use /dodatapacks <world> to paste the above file to the specified world


**Note: Make sure the server's default world name is WORLD**

# 中文描述

**将特定目录中的数据包文件夹添加给所有世界。以此来保护您的破限高服务器中非world世界导出后数据丢失**


_**使用方法** ：_
- 在plugins/DPcopy/dp中粘贴datapacks文件夹及其子文件
- 在游戏中使用/doalldatapacks 将上述文件粘贴至所有非world世界
- 在游戏中使用/dodatapacks <world> 将上述文件粘贴至指定世界


### **注意：请确保服务器默认世界名为world**
